text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, some time after the Arima Kinen. 
Vodka was furious.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, what is Scarlet's deal?! I told 
her not to overdo it, but she ignored me, 
went to train on her own, and collapsed!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Got troubles, huh...? Well, guess I 
have no choice! Time for me to lend a 
hand!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...So, what is it? Dragging me all the 
way out here."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I heard this place is super relaxing. I 
don't know what's eating at ya, but 
today's on me, so cheer up!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hah!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, things didn't quite go 
the way Vodka had hoped—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Scarlet, they say there's a dolphin show 
over there!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Not interested. Why don't you just go by 
yourself?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I heard you can touch starfish over there. 
Wanna go check it out?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: No. Not going.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hey, that feels awful!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You're the one who dragged me out here in 
the first place.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wha—and after I went through all the 
trouble—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You're the last person I want pity or 
concern from!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hah!? What's that supposed to mean!? 
...Wait, hey, the light is red!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Pfft!)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: What do you think you're doing, you idiot!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Ghhh. Ugh, ugh, ugh! This is the 
worst...! I'm the absolute worst...!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I rushed and ruined my condition! And as 
if feeling miserable wasn't enough, having 
everyone worry about me just makes it 
worse!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Even though you didn't do anything wrong, 
I got pissed off on my own and took it out 
on you!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Scarlet...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...No, sorry. My bad too. Dragging you 
out when I don't even know what's 
bothering you..."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Fine, I'll say it. Jeez.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
—Not once in a G1! Not even once could I 
beat you...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, right now?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Shut up! I know it's already over! But 
it's just so frustrating!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The more I think about it... the more I 
feel like I could have done better! That's 
why—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
*Sniff*...! No, seriously, I'm so totally 
uncool...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hey. Sure, I've won a whole lot of GⅠs.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
“That was only because you were there, 
though. Knowing I couldn't afford to lose 
fired me up. That's why I could give it 
everything I had.”

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...If you weren't there, I wouldn't have 
won that much. At least, that's what I 
believe."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
... ...What's with this all of a sudden? 
That kind of thing—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Well, but... ...I was being a little 
too stubborn.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Daiwa Scarlet walked away, her steps 
felt... somehow unusually light.
